channel.title: TCEA Vibe-Coded Solutions — Updates
channel.description: New and updated HTML tools, dashboards, prompt libraries, and classroom resources from TCEA.

item.title: 🎲 Endangered Today (Relic Room)
item.description: A grades 6-8 technology and economics investigation (Relic Rooms series) about everyday things fading now — cursive, cash, car keys, landlines, paper maps, newspapers, DVDs, checks, and passwords. Students identify each, how it is used today, and what is likely to replace it. Seven languages, aligned to the Texas Technology Applications TEKS (19 TAC Ch. 126).

item.title: 🎲 Hall of Inventions (Relic Room)
item.description: A grades 4-8 investigation (Relic Rooms series) about world-changing inventions — the printing press, light bulb, telephone, steam engine, vaccine, wheel, compass, airplane, and transistor. Students identify each, the problem it solved, and what it made possible. Seven languages, aligned to the Texas TEKS (19 TAC Ch. 113 + Ch. 126).

item.title: 🎲 Cloud Detective (Relic Room)
item.description: A grades 3-5 science investigation (Relic Rooms series) about clouds — cumulus, cumulonimbus, stratus, cirrus, nimbostratus, and more. Students identify each cloud, describe what it is like, and predict the weather it signals. Seven languages, aligned to the Texas science TEKS (19 TAC Ch. 112).

item.title: 🎲 Mystery Minerals (Relic Room)
item.description: A grades 5-8 science investigation (Relic Rooms series) about minerals — quartz, halite, graphite, talc, magnetite, gold, diamond, calcite, and hematite. Students identify each specimen, a key property (hardness, streak, magnetism, reaction to acid), and how people use it. Seven languages, aligned to the Texas science TEKS (19 TAC Ch. 112).

item.title: 🎲 Dead Communications (Relic Room)
item.description: A grades 4-8 technology investigation (Relic Rooms series) about old ways people sent messages — telegraph, telegram, carrier pigeon, pneumatic tube, party line, pay phone, fax, pager, and answering machine. Students identify each tool, what it was used for, and the modern equivalent. Seven languages, aligned to the Texas Technology Applications TEKS (19 TAC Ch. 126).

item.title: 🎲 The Transportation Graveyard (Relic Room)
item.description: A grades 3-6 social studies investigation (Relic Rooms series) about old ways of getting around — penny-farthing, steam locomotive, zeppelin, stagecoach, ocean liner, Concorde, and more. Students identify each vehicle, what it was used for, and what replaced it. Seven languages, aligned to the Texas social studies TEKS (19 TAC Ch. 113).

item.title: 🎲 Relic Rooms
item.description: A series of self-contained, seven-language investigation activities: students examine nine illustrated mystery exhibits in three steps — identify it, understand its purpose, and connect it to what came next. Aligned to the Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills across science, social studies, technology applications, and career. Starts with The Vanished Classroom.

item.title: 🎲 Extinct Creatures (Relic Room)
item.description: A grades 3-7 science investigation (Relic Rooms series) about nine extinct animals — dodo, woolly mammoth, T. rex, megalodon, and more. Students identify each creature, its role or adaptation, and its closest living relative today. Seven languages, aligned to the Texas science TEKS (19 TAC Ch. 112).

item.title: 🎲 Vanished Trades (Relic Room)
item.description: A grades 5-8 social studies and career investigation (Relic Rooms series) about jobs the modern world left behind — lamplighter, switchboard operator, iceman, human computer, and more. Students identify each trade, what the worker did, and what replaced the job. Seven languages, aligned to the Texas TEKS (19 TAC Ch. 113 + Ch. 127).

item.title: 🎲 The Vanished Classroom
item.description: A standalone investigation activity (grades 4-8) about instructional practices from the 1800s that classrooms no longer use. Students examine nine teaching relics — slate, hornbook, recitation, the dunce cap, and more — and uncover each one's purpose, limitation, and modern replacement. Seven languages, with a score and printable reflection. Part of the Relic Rooms series.

item.title: 🤖 Build Your Handbook: Claude vs. ChatGPT
item.description: One staff-handbook PDF, rebuilt as an accessible web page by two AI assistants — Claude and ChatGPT. Open each version side by side and compare the layout, navigation, and reading experience against the original source PDF.

item.title: 📊 Digital Capacity Matrix for the SPR Pathfinders
item.description: A self-assessment matrix across eight capacity areas — choose the statement that best fits where you are today and get a summary with next steps.

item.title: 📘 Comprehensive High-Impact Learning Phases
item.description: A visual reference for surface, deep, and transfer learning with strategy recommendations.

item.title: 🕵️ Critical Thinking Online Breakouts — Full Library
item.description: A single searchable library of every TCEA Critical Thinking Online Breakout (CTOB) — 193 self-contained, browser-based reasoning escapes across five suites (CLEAR, Fourth of July, July 5 & Black Freedom Holidays, Bible as Literature, and Science) in seven languages. Search by name, topic, or grade; no logins, no data collected.

item.title: ⭐ Vibe Coding a Free ShareSpace
item.description: A slide-style walkthrough for building a free Padlet-style sharing space with a downloadable demo solution.

item.title: 🧰 Classroom Coin Flipper
item.description: A coin flipping utility with themes and classroom-friendly controls.

item.title: 🧰 Color Pop Magic
item.description: A scratch-canvas drawing tool for revealing hidden backgrounds with a custom cover color and pen.

item.title: 🎲 Apps by OneScreen
item.description: A showcase of purpose-built classroom apps for educators tired of AI tools that miss the mark.

item.title: 🖥️ AI as Your Instructional Design Partner
item.description: A web-based slide deck on using AI as a partner in instructional design.

item.title: 🕵️ Critical Thinking Breakouts
item.description: Grade-band breakout activities (3-5, 6-8, 9-12) across ELA, science, and social studies that teach evidence-based reasoning, available in seven languages.

item.title: 🕵️ Fourth of July Critical Thinking Breakouts
item.description: Twelve self-contained U.S. history escape activities across three grade bands (3-5, 6-8, 9-12). Students open clues, weigh evidence, and crack four locks each — building history knowledge and critical-thinking habits. No logins, no data collected.

item.title: 🕵️ July 5 & Black Freedom Holidays Breakouts
item.description: Twelve self-contained critical thinking breakouts across three grade bands (3-5, 6-8, 9-12) exploring the freedom days the calendar often overlooks — Frederick Douglass s July 5 address, Juneteenth, Pinkster, Watch Night, and more. Students open clues, weigh evidence, and crack four locks each. No logins, no data collected.

item.title: 🕵️ Science Critical Thinking Breakouts (Grades K–8)
item.description: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts across the Texas science TEKS, Grades K–8 — from pushes and pulls to conservation of mass. Each grade has a featured breakout, a concept set, a hands-on STEM engineering design challenge, and a student word bank, in seven languages.

item.title: 🤖 TCEA AI Custom Instructions Library
item.description: Reusable AI personas and custom instructions for productivity, planning, writing, and educator workflows.

item.title: 🤖 Generative AI Adoption Checklist
item.description: A step-by-step institutional checklist for thoughtful generative AI adoption.

item.title: 🤖 Generative AI Adoption Checklist Folder Version
item.description: A packaged folder version of the adoption checklist for distribution or embedding.

item.title: 📘 Beyond the 20 Percent Policy
item.description: Classroom strategy guidance for responding to restrictive AI policies with better instructional design.

item.title: 📘 Visible Learning with Ed Tech
item.description: A practical reference for phases, strategies, frameworks, and effect sizes for educators and leaders.

item.title: 🎲 When Disaster Strikes
item.description: A K-12 cyber incident response tabletop game aligned to NIST CSF 2.0 and CISA guidance.

item.title: 🕵️ Idioms & Sayings for Multilingual Learners
item.description: A multilingual idioms & sayings suite for grades 3–12 — decode English idioms with your home language as a resource (ESL) and compare sayings across languages. 12 breakouts fully translated into seven languages (including French & Latin units for world-language classrooms), a 66-idiom illustrated spotlight, a three-game Idiom Arcade, printable card decks, and teacher UDL/ELPS/lesson-plan supports. Aligned to the Texas ELPS (idiomatic expressions) and WIDA; no logins, no data collected.

item.title: 🕵️ Idiom Arcade — 3 Idiom Games
item.description: Three fast, free, self-contained arcade games that teach English idioms: Match Blitz (timed idiom–meaning matching), Meaning Meteors (a catch-the-meaning canvas arcade), and Trap Escape (a literal-vs-figurative reflex game). Playable by touch, mouse, or keyboard; runs entirely in the browser with no logins and no data collected.

item.title: 🕵️ Idioms & Sayings Standards Alignment (ELPS / TEKS)
item.description: How the Idioms & Sayings suite aligns to the Texas ELPS (19 TAC §74.4), the ELAR TEKS, and the LOTE TEKS for Bilingual/ESL and multilingual classrooms — with a K–12 public-school appropriateness statement and links to the Texas EL program frameworks.

item.title: 🕵️ Bible as Literature Breakouts
item.description: Thirty-one critical-thinking breakouts on the Texas-adopted Bible stories, studied academically — as literature and history, never devotionally. Covers every K–12 required-list Bible item (creation, Noah, David & Goliath, the Psalms, the Prodigal Son, Job, 1 Corinthians 13, and more) across four grade bands, in seven languages.

item.title: 🕵️ Bible as Literature Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A TEKS correlation guide mapping each Bible as Literature breakout to the ELAR strands, the CLEAR reasoning focus, and the high-effect-size instructional strategy engineered into its locks.

item.title: 🕵️ Science Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A standards correlation guide mapping the Science Critical Thinking Breakouts by grade to the Texas science TEKS and the reasoning moves engineered into each lock.

item.title: 🕵️ Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A multilingual correlation guide mapping the Critical Thinking Breakouts to standards and thinking skills.

item.title: 🕵️ Fourth of July Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A standards correlation guide mapping the twelve Fourth of July breakouts by grade band to Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills, Common Core literacy standards, and the CLEAR thinking process.

item.title: 🕵️ Black Freedom Holidays Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A standards correlation guide mapping the twelve July 5 & Black Freedom Holidays breakouts by grade band to Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills, Common Core literacy standards, and the CLEAR thinking process.

item.title: 🕵️ Breakouts Answer Key
item.description: The facilitator answer key and recording sheet for running the Critical Thinking Breakouts activities.

item.title: 📊 Data Display Patterns
item.description: A TCEA field guide to choosing the right chart and data-display pattern for dashboards and reports.
